text: Testing plays a vital role in software development. Unit tests check small pieces of code, like individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests, on the other hand, verify that different parts of a system work together smoothly. A popular method is test-driven development, where you write a test before the actual code, which helps you think about the desired outcome first. All these practices give developers confidence. When you know your code is covered by tests, you can make changes or add features without fear of breaking something that already works. This saves time and reduces stress, especially in larger projects.
